description: Localização em tempo-real dos autocarros STCP is a dataset listed in data.gov.pt, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Sociedade de Transportes Colectivos do Porto (STCP). Real-time location of STCP vehicles in use, obtained by means of information in "Vehicle" format (SmartDataModels) with GPS coordinate identification. Coverage: Sociedade de Transportes Colectivos do Porto (STCP). The portal shows the English title as "Real-time location of STCP buses" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Sociedade de Transportes Colectivos do Porto (STCP). Its keywords include mobilidade, opendata-porto-digital. The listing shows 1 download or service links in NGSI. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (http://www.opendefinition.org/licenses/cc-zero). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-dados-gov-pt.
